comparison.objective: Test three cable cores with a cranked insulation tester and flag the faulty core; candidate calibrates a gripper opening stop.
comparison.physical_skill: Requires continuous cranking while holding and repositioning a probe, then diagnosis and marking; candidate requires coaxial driver/wrench seating and countertorque.
comparison.success_condition: Scores tested cores, correct fault flag, probe return, and stillness, with safety-related invalidations; candidate scores angle, nut retention, repeated motion, drift, and clearance.
comparison.reason: Shared simultaneous bimanual action is generic; electrical probing and diagnosis test a different ability from mechanical adjustment locking.
